description:
Bind the addressing core's named-project scope token to project identity so a `@<project>` address distinguishes the local project (which resolves) from any other named project (which is syntactically valid but not resolvable locally), per this epic's REQ-09 and design decision D5. This item adds no path parsing of its own and builds no federation or remote lookup — only the local-vs-other resolution binding and its command-layer wiring.

## Amendment (invoker-approved 2026-07-03)

The original task text asserted prerequisite work had extended `Scope` with a `NamedProject` variant. The accepted d6c3bff6 design instead keeps `Scope` two-variant and carries the named-project token on the deliberately separate `AddressScope` type (`crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs`, produced by `parse_kind_segmented_address`; see its doc comment for why `Scope` was not extended). This task binds `AddressScope::NamedProject` and also owns the `commands/item.rs` wiring that the `resolve_item_address` NamedProject arm's hook comment assigns to this task. It depends on task 3d9e9222 for the configured project-name getter.

What to build:

In `crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs` (pure domain, no I/O — the caller supplies the already-loaded config value):
- A resolution-facing pure function (or method on `AddressScope`) that takes the declared local project name (`Option<&str>` — `None` when the config declares no name) and binds the scope token:
  - `AddressScope::Project` (bare `@`) resolves as the local project, unchanged from today.
  - `AddressScope::NamedProject(name)` where `name` equals the declared local project name resolves identically to the bare-`@` local scope.
  - `AddressScope::NamedProject(name)` where `name` differs (or no local name is declared) returns a clear not-resolvable error.
  - Issue-scoped address forms pass through the binding unchanged (they carry no project identity).
- A new `ItemError` variant following the existing `thiserror` enum pattern, e.g. `ItemError::NotResolvable { project: String }`, whose `#[error(...)]` message names the unresolvable project and states plainly that resolution is local-only and no federation or remote lookup was attempted.

In `crates/jit/src/commands/item.rs`:
- Wire the `resolve_item_address` NamedProject arm through the new binding, supplying the configured project name via task 3d9e9222's getter (`ConfigManager::get_project_name`/`project_name_from_config`); replace the stopgap "not yet supported" error and its hook comment.
- Replace the stopgap test `test_show_item_named_project_address_not_yet_supported` with tests of the new contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: unit tests in `domain/item.rs` prove that, given a declared local project name (e.g. `"acme"`), the binding resolves both the bare-`@` scope and `AddressScope::NamedProject("acme")` as the local project, consuming the structurally parsed scope token rather than re-parsing or re-implementing any `@`-prefix matching.
- [hard] REQ-02: a unit test proves the binding maps `AddressScope::NamedProject("other-project")` (local name `"acme"`) to `Err(ItemError::NotResolvable { project })`, with a `to_string()` message that contains `"other-project"` and states resolution is local-only with no network or remote attempt; a test also covers the no-declared-name case (any named-project reference is not resolvable).
- [hard] REQ-03: `resolve_item_address`'s NamedProject arm routes through the binding using the configured project-name getter: tests show a `@<declared-name>/<kind>/<self-id>` address resolving identically to its `@/<kind>/<self-id>` form in a repo whose config declares that name, and a `@<other-name>/...` address returning the not-resolvable error; the stopgap "not yet supported" error and its test are replaced.
- [hard] REQ-04: `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` are green.
title: Bind the named-project scope token to local resolution or a not-resolvable error
